nodes.description: Activates an Artifact Registry for an organization by claiming a slug. Does not activate Artifact Registry if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.4: Status: Experiment.
nodes.name: mutation.artifactRegistryActivate

nodes.description: Deletes one artifact of an Artifact Registry repository. Permanently deletes a published artifact on a hosted repository and evicts a cached artifact on a remote repository, following the kind of the repository addressed. On a hosted repository, the delete cannot be undone. Artifact Registry accepts the request rather than completing it, so the mutation reports acceptance rather than completion. Re-read the artifact list to see the result. Does not delete the artifact if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.4: Status: Experiment.
nodes.name: mutation.artifactRegistryArtifactDelete

nodes.description: Deletes a container tag, identified by its name. Applies only to container repositories in Docker or OCI format. This mutation never reads the repository kind. Artifact Registry decides the outcome from its own records. On a hosted repository, deletion permanently removes the tag and cannot be undone. On a remote repository, it evicts the cached tag reference. On a virtual repository, the request is passed through for Artifact Registry to decide. Deleting a tag never removes the manifest it pointed at. Artifact Registry accepts the request rather than completing it, so this mutation reports acceptance, not completion. Does not delete the tag if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.4: Status: Experiment.
nodes.name: mutation.artifactRegistryContainerTagDelete

nodes.description: Disables Artifact Registry for the organization resolved from the request context (the X-GitLab-Organization-ID header, or the user default organization). Does not disable Artifact Registry if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.4: Status: Experiment.
nodes.name: mutation.artifactRegistryDisable

nodes.description: Enables Artifact Registry for the organization resolved from the request context (the X-GitLab-Organization-ID header, or the user default organization). Does not enable Artifact Registry if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.4: Status: Experiment.
nodes.name: mutation.artifactRegistryEnable

nodes.description: Deletes a manifest, identified by its digest. Applies only to Docker or OCI container repositories, whose kind this mutation never reads. Artifact Registry decides the outcome from its records, permanently removing the manifest on a hosted repository, evicting the cached copy on a remote one, or passing the request through on a virtual one. On a hosted repository, the delete cannot be undone. Deleting a manifest removes tags pointing at it and index entries where it is the parent, though a manifest it indexed survives untagged. Artifact Registry accepts rather than completes the request, so this reports acceptance. Re-read the image's manifests afterward for the result. Does not delete the manifest if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.4: Status: Experiment.
nodes.name: mutation.artifactRegistryManifestDelete

nodes.description: Deletes up to 1000 manifests of one image, by digest. Applies to Docker and OCI repositories only. On a hosted repository, the delete is permanent and cannot be undone. On a remote repository, it evicts cached copies. A virtual repository holds no manifests, so the mutation returns not found in `errors`. Deleting a manifest removes its tags. Artifact Registry applies the batch in the background, so the mutation reports acceptance, not completion, and a manifest can still be listed until the batch reaches it. Only the named manifests are deleted: deleting an index leaves the manifests it indexes. A manifest that an index outside the batch references is skipped and not reported. Does not delete manifests if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.6: Status: Experiment.

nodes.description: Permanently deletes one dist-tag of an npm package in an Artifact Registry repository, addressed by its Artifact Registry ID. Applies to npm repositories only. A non-npm repository is refused before any request reaches Artifact Registry, and the refusal appears in the payload errors. A remote repository is refused the same way, because Artifact Registry holds the dist-tags of a remote repository as a rewritten document rather than as individually addressable rows, so there is no dist-tag row to delete. Removes the dist-tag alone, never the version it named. The delete cannot be undone. The mutation reports acceptance rather than completion. Does not delete the dist-tag if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.4: Status: Experiment.

nodes.description: Deletes every artifact of an Artifact Registry repository. On a hosted repository, the delete cannot be undone. Artifact Registry accepts the request rather than completing it, so the mutation reports acceptance rather than completion. Re-read the artifact list to see the result. Does not delete the artifacts if the `artifact_registry_ui` feature flag is disabled. Introduced in GitLab 19.4: Status: Experiment.

Permanently deletes a published version on a hosted repository and evicts a cached version on a remote repository, following the kind of the repository addressed. nodes.description: Deletes up to 1000 versions of one package in an Artifact Registry repository, each with its files. On a hosted repository, the delete is permanent and cannot be undone. On a remote repository, it evicts cached versions. A virtual repository holds no versions, so the mutation returns not found in `errors`. Artifact Registry applies the batch in the background, so the mutation reports acceptance rather than completion, and a version can still be listed until the batch reaches it. """
Marks a field as introduced in a specific version. Fields tagged with the current milestone or a later one return null when the field is absent from the schema.
"""
directive @gl_introduced(
  """The version when this field was introduced (e.g. '18.1.0')"""
  version: String!
) on FIELD | INLINE_FRAGMENT

"""
Declares the granular personal access token permissions required to access a field or type, along with the authorization boundary (project, group, user, or instance) those permissions apply to. A field or type can also opt out of granular token authorization by giving a skip reason.
"""
directive @granularScope(
  """Granular scope permissions required to access the field or type."""
  permissions: [String!]

  """
  The type of authorization boundary (project, group, user, instance). Used for validation and documentation of the permission boundary.
  """
  boundaryType: PermissionBoundary

  """
  Reason the field or type intentionally opts out of granular token authorization. 
  """
  skipReason: String

  """
  Permissions a type skipped with `parent_authorizes` needs. Every field that returns the type checks them on the boundary of the field's parent object.
  """
  parentAuthorizes: [String!]

  """
  Method name to call on the resolved object to extract the authorization boundary (Project/Group). Use when the object is already resolved (fields on types, nested fields).
  """
  boundary: String

  """
  Argument name containing the authorization boundary (path or GlobalID). Use for mutations and query fields where the boundary is passed as an argument.
  """
  boundaryArgument: String

  """
  Conditions the current user must meet for the permissions to be offered in the token creation UI. Not a security control: the type, mutation, or field must still enforce the conditions. Valid values: admin, gitlab_team_member, saas, self_managed.
  """
  assignableWhen: [String!]
) on FIELD_DEFINITION | OBJECT

"""
Mean time to remediation for a single weekly (Monday to Sunday) bucket, with optional breakdowns by severity and report type
"""
type MttrOverTimeBucket {
  """Remediation metrics for the bucket broken down by report type."""
  byReportType: [MttrOverTimeByReportType!]!

  """Remediation metrics for the bucket broken down by severity."""
  bySeverity: [MttrOverTimeBySeverity!]!

  """
  Number of vulnerabilities remediated in the bucket. Denominator of the MTTR average.
  """
  count: Int!

  """
  End of the weekly bucket (Sunday). Capped at the current date, so the most recent bucket may be partial.
  """
  endDate: ISO8601Date!

  """
  Mean time to remediation, in days (sumDays / count). Null when no vulnerabilities were remediated in the bucket.
  """
  mttr: Float

  """Start of the weekly bucket (Monday)."""
  startDate: ISO8601Date!

  """
  Sum of remediation time, in days, across vulnerabilities remediated in the bucket. Numerator of the MTTR average.
  """
  sumDays: Float!
}

"""
Mean time to remediation for a single report type within a weekly bucket
"""
type MttrOverTimeByReportType {
  """Number of vulnerabilities of the report type remediated in the bucket."""
  count: Int!

  """
  Mean time to remediation for the report type, in days (sumDays / count). Null when the count is 0.
  """
  mttr: Float

  """Report type the breakdown applies to."""
  reportType: VulnerabilityReportType!

  """
  Sum of remediation time, in days, across vulnerabilities of the report type remediated in the bucket.
  """
  sumDays: Float!
}

"""Mean time to remediation for a single severity within a weekly bucket"""
type MttrOverTimeBySeverity {
  """Number of vulnerabilities of the severity remediated in the bucket."""
  count: Int!

  """
  Mean time to remediation for the severity, in days (sumDays / count). Null when the count is 0.
  """
  mttr: Float

  """Severity the breakdown applies to."""
  severity: VulnerabilitySeverity!

  """
  Sum of remediation time, in days, across vulnerabilities of the severity remediated in the bucket.
  """
  sumDays: Float!
}

"""Represents security metrics"""
type SecurityMetrics {
  """
  Weekly mean time to remediation (MTTR) of vulnerabilities. Each week only counts vulnerabilities detected no earlier than 90 days before the week starts, so a week's MTTR is at most about 97 days. Returns `null` unless the `security_dashboard_mttr_chart` feature flag is enabled.

  """

    """
    Start date of the time range. Snapped back to the start of its week (Monday) so results align to full Monday to Sunday buckets.
    """
    startDate: ISO8601Date!

    """
    End date of the time range. Snapped forward to the end of its week (Sunday), capped at the current date. The most recent week may be partial. The range can span at most 12 weeks.
    """
    endDate: ISO8601Date!

    """Filter vulnerabilities by severity."""
    severity: [VulnerabilitySeverity!]
  ): [MttrOverTimeBucket!] @deprecated(reason: "Status: Experiment. Introduced in GitLab 19.5.")

  """
  Total risk score information. By default, excludes vulnerabilities that are no longer detected on the default branch.
  This feature is currently under development and not yet available for general use. Introduced in GitLab 18.4: Status: Experiment.
  """
  riskScore(
    """
    Filters vulnerabilities by whether they are no longer detected on the default branch. If true, includes only those vulnerabilities. If false (default), excludes them.
    """
    hasResolution: Boolean = false
  ): RiskScore @deprecated(reason: "Status: Experiment. Introduced in GitLab 18.4.")

  """
  Vulnerability age statistics based on predefined age bands.
  See [`VulnerabilitiesByAge`](#vulnerabilitiesbyage) for details.
  This feature is currently under development and not yet available for general use Introduced in GitLab 18.9: Status: Experiment.
  """

    """Filter vulnerabilities by severity."""
    severity: [VulnerabilitySeverity!]
  ): [VulnerabilitiesByAge!] @deprecated(reason: "Status: Experiment. Introduced in GitLab 18.9.")

  """
  Vulnerability identifier statistics with filtering.
  This feature is currently under development and not yet available for general use Introduced in GitLab 18.10: Status: Experiment.
  """
  vulnerabilitiesByIdentifier(
    """Filter vulnerabilities by severity."""
    severity: [VulnerabilitySeverity!]
  ): [VulnerabilitiesByIdentifier!] @deprecated(reason: "Status: Experiment. Introduced in GitLab 18.10.")

  """
  Vulnerability metrics over time with filtering and grouping capabilities.
  This feature is currently under development and not yet available for general use
  """
  vulnerabilitiesOverTime(
    """Start date for the vulnerability metrics time range."""
    startDate: ISO8601Date!

    """
    End date for the vulnerability metrics time range. The end date should be within 31 days from the start date.
    """
    endDate: ISO8601Date!

    """Filter vulnerabilities by severity."""
    severity: [VulnerabilitySeverity!]

    """
    Returns the elements in the list that come before the specified cursor.

    startDate: ISO8601Date @deprecated(reason: "Status: Experiment. Introduced in GitLab 18.3.")

    """
    End date for the vulnerability metrics time range. Optional. Introduced in GitLab 18.3: Status: Experiment.
    """
    endDate: ISO8601Date @deprecated(reason: "Status: Experiment. Introduced in GitLab 18.3.")
  ): VulnerabilitiesPerSeverity
